listen_address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) on which the DNS server listens for incoming queries.

listen_port.description: UDP/TCP port number to bind for DNS queries (typically 53).

max_udp_size.description: Maximum size in bytes of UDP responses (EDNS0 buffer size hint).

tcp_fallback.description: If true, fall back to TCP for responses exceeding UDP size limits.

min_negative_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (seconds) for negative caching (e.g., NXDOMAIN responses).

max_connections.description: Maximum concurrent client connections (0 = no limit).

chroot_dir.description: Path to chroot directory after startup (empty string to disable chroot).

user.description: System user account to drop privileges to after startup.

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup.

tls.enabled.description: Enable DNS over TLS (DoT) on a dedicated port.

tls.listen_address.description: IP address for TLS listener (empty = reuse main listen_address).

tls.cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format).

tls.key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

log.syslog.description: Whether to send logs to syslog.

log.file.description: Optional path to a log file (empty = log only to stderr/syslog).

log.level.description: Minimum log level (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg).

zones.description: List of DNS zones served by this server.

file.description: Path to zone data file (relative to zonefile directory, e.g., /var/lib/gdnsd/zones/).

allow_axfr.description: List of client IP addresses or prefixes allowed to request zone transfers (AXFR).

allow_notify.description: List of secondary server IPs allowed to send zone update notifications.

dnssec.description: Whether to sign this zone with DNSSEC.

soa.description: Optional custom SOA parameters (defaults used if omitted).

dynamic_updates.description: Enable dynamic DNS updates (RFC 2136) for specified zones.

dynamic_update_zones.description: List of zone names allowed to receive dynamic updates.
